g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Title: Jackal: smart port power test board

g.desc: Title: Jackal: smart port power test board

g.text: USB-C is the built-in USB serial and JTAG port: flash and print over one cable.

g.desc: USB-C is the built-in USB serial and JTAG port: flash and print over one cable.

g.text: 5V_LDO is fed by 5V through D2, or by USB through D4 and Q1.

g.desc: 5V_LDO is fed by 5V through D2, or by USB through D4 and Q1.

g.text: TPSM53602 set to 5.0 V: RFBT 10k, RFBB 2.49k (datasheet Table 7-1). 1.4 MHz fixed.

g.desc: TPSM53602 set to 5.0 V: RFBT 10k, RFBB 2.49k (datasheet Table 7-1). 1.4 MHz fixed.

g.text: EN tied to VIN. AGND joins PGND at the module. Input 2 x 10u, output 2 x 47u.

g.desc: EN tied to VIN. AGND joins PGND at the module. Input 2 x 10u, output 2 x 47u.

g.text: Power flags (tell ERC these nets are driven)

g.desc: Power flags (tell ERC these nets are driven)

g.text: Q1's gate sits on the 5 V rail: robot or bench power on turns Q1 off, so USB only carries data.

g.desc: Q1's gate sits on the 5 V rail: robot or bench power on turns Q1 off, so USB only carries data.

g.text: Test points are bare 3.4 x 1.8 mm copper pads, nothing to buy.

g.desc: Test points are bare 3.4 x 1.8 mm copper pads, nothing to buy.

g.text: Same land as a Keystone 5015, so a loop can be soldered on later.

g.desc: Same land as a Keystone 5015, so a loop can be soldered on later.

g.text: D5 and D3 OR the two inputs. Either can be plugged in alone or both at once.

g.desc: D5 and D3 OR the two inputs. Either can be plugged in alone or both at once.

g.text: Route IN+ and IN- as Kelvin traces from the inside edge of each shunt pad.

g.desc: Route IN+ and IN- as Kelvin traces from the inside edge of each shunt pad.

g.text: Separate 5.1k on each CC pin. USB D+/D- reach GPIO19/GPIO18 through 22 ohm R24, R25.

g.desc: Separate 5.1k on each CC pin. USB D+/D- reach GPIO19/GPIO18 through 22 ohm R24, R25.

g.text: Meter the J1 pinout before the first plug-in. A wrong pinout can put battery on GND.

g.desc: Meter the J1 pinout before the first plug-in. A wrong pinout can put battery on GND.

g.text: UART0 (GPIO20/21) is not broken out. USB-C is the console.

g.desc: UART0 (GPIO20/21) is not broken out. USB-C is the console.

g.text: Hold BOOT, tap RESET for download mode. R21, R22 hold the GPIO2 and GPIO8 straps high.

g.desc: Hold BOOT, tap RESET for download mode. R21, R22 hold the GPIO2 and GPIO8 straps high.
